name: Beijing New Space Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing New Space Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of professional contracting services for urban and road lighting engineering in China. The company offers smart streetlamps, which provides a complete system platform and solutions, including intelligent lighting, communication services, video and environmental monitoring, energy services, security monitoring, information interaction, and municipal services. It is also involved in systematically building core theme brands based on the night economies, developing corresponding night tour products, and making coordinated arrangements for thematic activities and supporting services.
